description: Read-only, lazy and memoized derived signal. Recalculates only when a signal it read changes.
A writable signal whose value is recomputed whenever its source signals change, so it resets without an effect.
Runs a side effect after the signals it reads change. Not a mechanism for computing state.
Signals notify consumers when the new value is not `Object.is` equal to the old one, so updates must create new objects and arrays.
